story: In 221 BCE the Qin army entered Qi, the last independent state, and King Jian of Qi surrendered without a fight. After more than two centuries of war, all the lands of the Zhou world were under one ruler.

King Zheng asked his ministers for a title worthy of his success. He chose Huangdi, combining the words for the legendary August Ones and Emperors, and called himself Shi Huangdi, the First Emperor. His heirs were to be the Second, Third and so on for ten thousand generations.

Guided by his chancellor Li Si, he made the whole empire use one system. The small seal script replaced the different scripts of the old states. Round coins with a square hole, the banliang, replaced spade and knife money. Weights, lengths and even the width of cart axles were standardized. Weapons from the conquered states were melted down into twelve huge bronze statues.
story_zh: 前221年，秦军开进最后一个独立国家齐国，齐王建不战而降。两百多年的战乱结束了，原来周朝的天下全部归于一人之手。
秦王嬴政让群臣为他商议一个配得上这番功业的称号。他最终选定“皇帝”二字，取自传说中的“三皇”“五帝”，自称“始皇帝”，后代依次称二世、三世，以至万世。
在丞相李斯的辅佐下，他在全国推行统一的制度：以小篆取代各国不同的文字；以圆形方孔的半两钱取代布币、刀币；统一度量衡，连车轴的宽度也一律相同。各国收缴来的兵器被熔铸成十二座巨大的铜人。
qin-unifies.why: Unification created the first Chinese empire and the idea, lasting to this day, that China should be one state.
qin-unifies.why_zh: 统一创造了中国第一个大一统帝国，也确立了中国应当统一的观念，一直延续至今。

quote.zh: 一法度衡石丈尺。车同轨。书同文字。
quote.en: He unified the laws and the measures of weight and length. Carts were given the same axle width, and writing the same characters.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: While Qin was busy conquering the six states, the Xiongnu nomads had moved into the Ordos, the grassland inside the great northern loop of the Yellow River. In 215 BCE the First Emperor sent his general Meng Tian north with 300,000 men. Meng Tian drove the Xiongnu out and set up new counties along the river.

To hold the frontier, Qin joined the walls that Qin, Zhao and Yan had each built earlier into one long line, said to stretch ten thousand li from Lintao in the west to Liaodong in the east. Most of it was rammed earth and stone, not the brick walls seen today, which are largely Ming.
The emperor's eldest son Fusu was sent to serve with Meng Tian. Meng Tian also built the Straight Road, a military highway from near Xianyang to Jiuyuan.
story_zh: 秦国忙于兼并六国之际，匈奴趁机占据了黄河大拐弯以内的河套草原。前215年，秦始皇派大将蒙恬率三十万大军北上，赶走匈奴，沿黄河设立新县。
为了守住边疆，秦朝把秦、赵、燕三国早先各自修筑的长城连接起来，据说西起临洮、东至辽东，绵延万里。这些城墙大多是夯土和石块筑成，并非今天常见的砖砌长城，后者大部分修于明代。
秦始皇的长子扶苏也被派到蒙恬军中。蒙恬还主持修建了从咸阳附近直通九原的军用大道“直道”。
great-wall-qin.why: The Qin wall began the long Chinese tradition of building walls against the steppe, but its forced labour also bred hatred of Qin.
great-wall-qin.why_zh: 秦长城开启了中原王朝修筑长城抵御草原民族的漫长传统，但沉重的徭役也激起了百姓对秦朝的怨恨。

people.name: Fusu
people.role: Eldest son of the First Emperor

story: From about 221 BCE Qin sent large armies south to conquer the Yue peoples of what is now Guangdong and Guangxi. The campaign stalled. The mountains made it very hard to bring food to the soldiers, and the first commander, Tu Sui, was killed in an attack.

The official Shi Lu was ordered to dig a canal. At Xing'an, the Xiang River, which flows north to the Yangtze, and the Li River, which flows south toward the Pearl River, come within a short distance of each other. Shi Lu's canal, a little over 30 kilometres long, joined them. A stone divider shaped like a ploughshare split the Xiang's water between the two branches.
With supplies flowing, Qin completed its conquest in 214 BCE and set up three commanderies in the far south.
story_zh: 约从前221年起，秦朝派大军南下，征讨今广东、广西一带的越人。战事一度陷入僵局：山岭重重，粮草难以运到前线，首任统帅屠睢也在越人袭击中战死。
监御史禄（史禄）奉命开凿运河。在广西兴安，向北流入长江的湘江与向南流向珠江的漓江相距很近。史禄开凿的灵渠全长三十多公里，把两条江连通起来，渠首用一道形似犁铧的石堤“铧嘴”把湘江水分入南北两渠。
粮道打通后，秦军于前214年完成征服，在岭南设立了三个郡。
lingqu.why: Lingqu tied the far south to the Chinese heartland. It is one of the oldest canals in the world still in use.
lingqu.why_zh: 灵渠把岭南与中原紧紧连在一起，是世界上现存最古老、仍在使用的运河之一。

people.name: Shi Lu
people.role: Qin official who built the canal
people.role_zh: 主持开凿灵渠的秦朝官员

story: In 213 BCE, at a palace banquet, the scholar Chunyu Yue urged the First Emperor to follow antiquity and give fiefs to his sons, as the Zhou kings had. The chancellor Li Si answered that scholars who used the past to criticize the present were spreading confusion.

On Li Si's advice, the emperor ordered that all histories except Qin's own be burned. Private copies of the Book of Songs, the Book of Documents and the works of the hundred schools had to be handed in and burned. Books on medicine, divination and farming were spared, and court scholars could keep copies. Anyone who discussed the Songs and Documents was to be executed.
The next year, angry at magicians who had cheated him and fled, the emperor had more than 460 scholars in Xianyang put to death.
story_zh: 前213年，在一次宫廷宴会上，博士淳于越劝秦始皇效法古代、像周天子那样分封子弟。丞相李斯反驳说，读书人以古非今，只会扰乱人心。
秦始皇采纳李斯的建议，下令除秦国史书外，其他各国史书一律焚毁；民间私藏的《诗》《书》和诸子百家著作必须上交烧掉，只有医药、卜筮、种树一类的书可以保留，朝廷博士官也可以收藏。敢私下谈论《诗》《书》的人处死。
第二年，秦始皇因为方士骗他之后逃走而大怒，在咸阳处死了四百六十多名儒生和方士。
book-burning.why: The burning destroyed many texts and made the First Emperor the classic image of a tyrant in later Confucian history.
book-burning.why_zh: 焚书使大量典籍失传，也让秦始皇在后世儒家史书中成为暴君的典型。

quote.zh: 臣请史官非秦记皆烧之。
quote.en: I request that all histories in the archives except the records of Qin be burned.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: In the seventh month of 209 BCE, about 900 poor conscripts were marching north to guard Yuyang, near modern Beijing. Heavy rain trapped them at Dazexiang, and they could not arrive on time. Under Qin law, they believed, lateness meant death.

Two of their leaders, Chen Sheng and Wu Guang, decided they had nothing to lose. They hid a cloth reading 'Chen Sheng will be king' inside a fish for the men to find, and at night Wu Guang imitated a fox crying 'Great Chu will rise'. They killed the officers escorting them and called on the men to rebel.

The rebels quickly took several towns and the city of Chen, where Chen Sheng declared himself king of 'Zhang Chu'. Within months, revolts broke out all over the former six states. Chen Sheng himself was killed by his own carriage driver about six months later.
story_zh: 前209年七月，九百名贫苦的戍卒被征发前往渔阳（今北京附近）戍边。大雨把他们困在大泽乡，眼看无法按期赶到。他们认为，按照秦法，误期就要处死。
屯长陈胜、吴广决定拼死一搏。他们把写有“陈胜王”的帛条塞进鱼肚子，让戍卒们“偶然”发现；夜里吴广又学狐狸叫，喊“大楚兴，陈胜王”。随后两人杀掉押送的军官，号召众人起义。
起义军很快攻下几座县城，又占领了陈县，陈胜在那里自立为王，国号“张楚”。几个月之内，原六国各地纷纷起兵反秦。大约半年后，陈胜被自己的车夫杀害。
dazexiang.why: It was the first great peasant uprising in Chinese history and it set off the collapse of the Qin.
dazexiang.why_zh: 这是中国历史上第一次大规模农民起义，揭开了秦朝覆灭的序幕。

quote.en: Are kings, lords, generals and ministers born to their rank?
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: After crushing Chen Sheng and killing the rebel leader Xiang Liang, the Qin general Zhang Han turned north. Qin forces under Wang Li besieged the restored King of Zhao at Julu. Many rebel armies came to help but camped nearby, too afraid to fight.

The Chu commander Song Yi also held back. His deputy Xiang Yu, Xiang Liang's nephew, killed him and took command. Xiang Yu led his men across the Zhang River, then sank the boats, smashed the cooking pots and gave each soldier three days of food, so that there was no way back.

The Chu army won nine clashes in a row, captured Wang Li and broke the siege. Afterwards the other rebel generals came to Xiang Yu on their knees. Zhang Han surrendered that summer. Later Xiang Yu had about 200,000 surrendered Qin soldiers killed at Xin'an.
story_zh: 秦将章邯镇压了陈胜，又杀死起义军首领项梁，随后挥师北上。王离率领的秦军把复国的赵王围困在巨鹿。各路援军虽然赶来，却在附近扎营观望，不敢出战。
楚军主将宋义也按兵不动。项梁的侄子、副将项羽杀了宋义，夺取兵权。他率军渡过漳河后，下令凿沉船只、砸破饭锅，每人只带三天口粮，以示有进无退，这就是“破釜沉舟”。
楚军九战九捷，俘虏王离，解了巨鹿之围。战后各路诸侯将领进见项羽，都跪着向前，不敢抬头。同年夏天章邯投降。后来项羽在新安把约二十万秦军降卒全部坑杀。
julu.why: Julu destroyed Qin's last great field army and made Xiang Yu the leader of the rebellion.
julu.why_zh: 巨鹿之战消灭了秦朝最后一支主力野战军，项羽也由此成为反秦诸军的盟主。

quote.zh: 皆沉船，破釜甑，烧庐舍，持三日粮，以示士卒必死，无一还心。
quote.en: They sank the boats, smashed the cooking pots, burned the huts and carried only three days' food, to show the soldiers they must fight to the death with no thought of return.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: Soon after unification, the chancellor Wang Wan proposed that the First Emperor's sons be made kings of the distant regions, as in Zhou times. Most ministers agreed. Li Si disagreed: the Zhou had given out fiefs to relatives, and within a few generations their descendants were at war with each other.

The emperor sided with Li Si. The empire was divided into 36 commanderies, a number that grew to more than 40 as new lands were added. Each commandery had a governor, a military commander and an inspector, all appointed and paid by the court and moved or dismissed at will. Commanderies were divided into counties.
No one held land or office by birth. The emperor's sons received only titles and income.
story_zh: 统一后不久，丞相王绾提议仿照周朝，封皇子为王，镇守远方，大多数大臣表示赞同。李斯却认为，周朝分封子弟，没过几代，各国后人就互相攻战。
秦始皇采纳了李斯的意见，把全国分为三十六郡，后来随着疆土扩大增加到四十多个。每郡设郡守、郡尉和监御史，都由朝廷任命、发放俸禄，可以随时调任或罢免。郡下再设县。
从此再没有人能凭出身世袭土地和官职，皇子们也只得到爵号和俸禄。
qin-commanderies.why: The system of commanderies and counties became the basic structure of Chinese government for the next two thousand years.
qin-commanderies.why_zh: 郡县制此后成为两千年间中国地方行政的基本框架。

quote.zh: 天下共苦战斗不休，以有侯王。
quote.en: The whole world has suffered from endless war because there were lords and kings.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: South of the Nanling mountains lived many Yue peoples, together called the Hundred Yue. Soon after unification, the First Emperor sent a huge army, said to be 500,000 men, to conquer them.

The Yue fought back by retreating into the forests and attacking at night. The Qin commander Tu Sui was killed and the army suffered heavy losses. Supplies were the biggest problem until the Lingqu canal was dug to carry grain by water across the mountains.

By 214 BCE Qin had taken the region and set up three commanderies: Nanhai, Guilin and Xiang. Large numbers of convicts and settlers were moved south to live among the Yue. One of the Qin officers, Zhao Tuo, later used this base to found the independent kingdom of Nanyue.
story_zh: 南岭以南生活着众多越人部族，统称“百越”。统一后不久，秦始皇派出据说多达五十万的大军南征。
越人退入山林，夜间出击。秦军统帅屠睢战死，伤亡惨重。最大的难题是补给，直到开凿灵渠、用水路越山运粮之后才得以解决。
到前214年，秦朝平定岭南，设立南海、桂林、象郡三郡，并把大批罪犯和移民迁到南方与越人杂居。秦军将领赵佗后来就以此为根基，建立了独立的南越国。
qin-baiyue.why: The conquest brought Guangdong and Guangxi into the Chinese world for the first time.
qin-baiyue.why_zh: 这次征服第一次把两广地区纳入中原王朝的版图。

people.name: Zhao Tuo
people.role: Qin officer, later King of Nanyue

story: The First Emperor made five long tours of his empire to show his power and inspect the conquered lands. On his tour of the east in 219 BCE, he gathered scholars from Qi and Lu to advise him on an ancient rite.

The scholars disagreed about how it should be done, so the emperor sent them away and made up his own ceremony. He climbed Mount Tai and performed the feng sacrifice to Heaven at the summit, then the shan sacrifice to Earth on a smaller hill nearby. On the way down a storm broke, and he sheltered under a tree, which he later honoured with an official rank.
A stone inscription praising his deeds, said to be written by Li Si, was set up on the mountain. Small fragments of it survive.
story_zh: 秦始皇先后五次长途巡游全国，宣扬威德，视察新征服的土地。前219年东巡时，他召集齐鲁儒生，请教一种古老的祭礼。
儒生们对礼仪说法不一，秦始皇便打发他们走，自定仪式。他登上泰山之巅祭天，称为“封”；又在附近的梁父山祭地，称为“禅”。下山时突遇暴风雨，他在一棵树下避雨，事后封这棵树为“五大夫”。
山上还立了一块歌颂他功德的石碑，相传碑文出自李斯之手，至今仍有残片保存。
taishan-feng.why: It made the feng and shan sacrifices on Mount Tai the highest ceremony an emperor could perform, copied by later rulers.
taishan-feng.why_zh: 此后泰山封禅成为帝王所能举行的最高典礼，为后世君主所效仿。

story: The First Emperor feared death and searched for ways to live forever. In 219 BCE, at Langya on the Shandong coast, a magician from Qi named Xu Fu told him that three islands of the immortals, Penglai, Fangzhang and Yingzhou, lay out at sea.

The emperor sent Xu Fu off with several thousand boys and girls to find them. He came back without success, saying great sharks blocked the way. On the emperor's last tour in 210 BCE, Xu Fu was sent out again, this time with archers and supplies, and never returned.
Later legends, first recorded centuries afterwards, say he reached Japan and settled there. Several places in Japan still claim his grave.
story_zh: 秦始皇畏惧死亡，到处寻找长生不老之法。前219年，在山东沿海的琅琊，齐地方士徐福上书说，海中有蓬莱、方丈、瀛洲三座仙山。
秦始皇便派徐福带着数千童男童女出海寻仙。徐福一无所获地回来，推说海上有大鲛鱼挡路。前210年秦始皇最后一次巡游时，又派徐福带着弓箭手和物资出海，这一次他再也没有回来。
几百年后才出现的传说称，徐福到了日本并在那里定居。如今日本仍有好几处地方自称有他的墓地。
xu-fu.why: Xu Fu's voyages show the First Emperor's obsession with immortality and became a lasting link in Chinese and Japanese legend.
xu-fu.why_zh: 徐福东渡反映了秦始皇对长生的执迷，也成为中日两国流传久远的传说。

story: Zhang Liang came from a family that had served as chief ministers of Han for five reigns. When Qin destroyed Han, he spent his family fortune looking for a way to take revenge.

He found a strongman and had an iron hammer made, said to weigh 120 jin. In 218 BCE, as the First Emperor's procession passed Bolangsha, the two men attacked from hiding. The hammer struck one of the carriages, but it was not the emperor's. The furious emperor ordered a ten-day search across the empire.

Zhang Liang escaped under a false name to Xiapi. There, according to the Records of the Grand Historian, an old man on a bridge tested his patience and gave him a book on military strategy. Zhang Liang later became Liu Bang's most trusted adviser.
story_zh: 张良出身韩国世家，祖父和父亲先后做过五代韩王的相国。秦灭韩后，他散尽家财，寻找报仇的机会。
他找到一个大力士，打造了一只据说重一百二十斤的铁锤。前218年，秦始皇的车队经过博浪沙，两人从埋伏处突然出击，铁锤砸中了一辆车，却不是秦始皇乘坐的那辆。秦始皇大怒，下令全国大搜捕十天。
张良改名换姓逃到下邳。据《史记》记载，他在桥上遇到一位老人，老人几番考验他的耐心后，送给他一部兵书。张良后来成了刘邦最信任的谋士。
bolangsha.why: The attack showed how deep resentment ran among the old nobility, and it launched the career of a key founder of the Han.
bolangsha.why_zh: 这次行刺说明六国旧贵族对秦怨恨极深，也开启了汉朝开国功臣张良的传奇生涯。

people.name: Zhang Liang
people.role: Han noble, later adviser to Liu Bang
people.role_zh: 韩国贵族后裔，后为刘邦谋士

story: By 212 BCE the First Emperor felt that Xianyang was too crowded and its palaces too small. He ordered a new palace complex in the Shanglin park south of the Wei River. Its front hall was to be the largest building in the empire.

According to the Records of the Grand Historian, the front hall measured 500 paces from east to west and could seat ten thousand people. More than 700,000 convicts and labourers were put to work on it and on the emperor's tomb at Mount Li. In the same year work began on the Straight Road to the northern frontier.

Excavations since 2002 have found the hall's huge rammed-earth platform but few signs of finished buildings or of burning, so the palace was probably never completed. Its fame comes mostly from a poem by the Tang writer Du Mu.
story_zh: 到前212年，秦始皇嫌咸阳人多、宫殿狭小，下令在渭河以南的上林苑修建新宫，其前殿要成为全国最大的建筑。
据《史记》记载，前殿东西宽五百步，可容纳上万人。为修建这座宫殿和骊山陵墓，朝廷征调了七十多万刑徒和民夫。同一年，通往北方边境的直道也开始修建。
2002年以来的考古发掘找到了前殿巨大的夯土台基，却很少发现建成的房屋或焚烧的痕迹，说明阿房宫很可能并未完工。它的名声主要来自唐代杜牧的《阿房宫赋》。
epang.why: The endless building projects drained the people and became a symbol of the reasons Qin fell so fast.
epang.why_zh: 没完没了的大工程耗尽了民力，成为秦朝速亡的象征。

story: In 210 BCE the First Emperor set out on his fifth tour, taking with him the chancellor Li Si, the eunuch Zhao Gao and his youngest son Huhai. He fell ill on the way back and died at Shaqiu. He had written a letter calling his eldest son Fusu to Xianyang for the funeral, which meant Fusu would succeed him.

Zhao Gao kept the letter. He persuaded Li Si that if Fusu became emperor, Meng Tian would replace Li Si as chancellor. The two forged new orders making Huhai heir and commanding Fusu and Meng Tian to kill themselves. Fusu obeyed.

To hide the death, they kept the body in the carriage and brought meals to it as usual. When it began to smell in the summer heat, they loaded carts of salted fish around it. Only when they reached Xianyang was the death announced, and Huhai became the Second Emperor.
story_zh: 前210年，秦始皇第五次出巡，随行的有丞相李斯、宦官赵高和小儿子胡亥。返程途中他染病，死在沙丘。临终前他写信召长子扶苏回咸阳主持丧事，这等于指定扶苏继位。
赵高扣下了这封信。他对李斯说，扶苏一旦即位，必然重用蒙恬，李斯的丞相之位就保不住了。两人于是伪造诏书，立胡亥为太子，命令扶苏和蒙恬自杀。扶苏接诏后自尽。
为了掩盖死讯，他们把遗体放在车中，照常进献饭食。时值盛夏，尸体发臭，他们就在车旁装上成车的咸鱼掩盖气味。直到回到咸阳才发丧，胡亥即位为秦二世。
shaqiu.why: The plot put a weak ruler and a scheming eunuch in charge, which led the empire to collapse within three years.
shaqiu.why_zh: 这场阴谋让一个无能的君主和一个奸诈的宦官掌握大权，帝国在三年内便土崩瓦解。

people.name: Fusu
people.role: Eldest son of the First Emperor

story: Work on the First Emperor's tomb at Mount Li had begun when he became king in 246 BCE, and after unification hundreds of thousands of labourers were sent there. He was buried in 210 BCE. The Records of the Grand Historian says the tomb chamber held models of palaces and rivers of flowing mercury, and was protected by automatic crossbows.

The great mound has never been opened. But in 1974, farmers digging a well about 1.5 kilometres to the east found pieces of clay figures. Archaeologists then uncovered pits holding an army of life-size soldiers, horses and chariots, estimated at about 8,000 figures.
Each soldier has a different face and hairstyle, and they were once brightly painted. Many carried real bronze weapons. The site became a UNESCO World Heritage site in 1987.
story_zh: 秦始皇在骊山的陵墓从他前246年即秦王位时就开始修建，统一后又调来数十万劳力。前210年他下葬于此。据《史记》记载，墓室中有宫殿模型，用水银做成江河湖海，还装有自动发射的弩机以防盗墓。
巨大的封土至今从未打开。1974年，农民在陵墓东面约一公里半处打井，挖出了陶俑碎片。考古学家随后发掘出一座座俑坑，里面排列着与真人真马一般大小的士兵、战马和战车，估计总数约有八千件。
每个陶俑的面容、发型各不相同，原本都涂着鲜艳的彩绘，许多还手持真正的青铜兵器。1987年，这里被列入世界文化遗产。
terracotta-army.why: The Terracotta Army shows the size and organisation of the Qin state and is one of the greatest archaeological finds in the world.
terracotta-army.why_zh: 兵马俑展现了秦帝国的规模和组织能力，是世界上最伟大的考古发现之一。

story: Liu Bang was a farmer's son from Pei, known for drinking, generosity and big talk. He served as a minor local officer, a tingzhang, in charge of a small post. Once, while escorting convicts to work on the emperor's tomb, so many escaped that he would surely be punished. He freed the rest and hid in the marshes and hills with a band of followers.

When Chen Sheng's revolt broke out in 209 BCE, the magistrate of Pei first thought of joining the rebels, then changed his mind. Local officials Xiao He and Cao Can had already sent for Liu Bang. The townspeople killed the magistrate, opened the gates and chose Liu Bang as their leader, with the title Lord of Pei.
His early companions, including Xiao He, Cao Can and the dog butcher Fan Kuai, became the core of the future Han government.
story_zh: 刘邦是沛县农家子弟，好酒、豪爽，爱说大话。他当过管理一个小亭的亭长。一次他押送刑徒去修骊山陵，途中逃走的人太多，自己肯定要获罪，索性把剩下的人也放了，带着一帮追随者躲进芒砀山的山泽之间。
前209年陈胜起义爆发，沛县县令起初想响应，随后又反悔。县吏萧何、曹参早已派人去请刘邦。城中百姓杀了县令，打开城门，推举刘邦为首领，号称“沛公”。
他早年的伙伴，如萧何、曹参和屠狗出身的樊哙，后来都成了汉朝开国的核心班底。
liu-bang-pei.why: A commoner's rise to lead a rebel army began the path that would make him the first emperor of the Han.
liu-bang-pei.why_zh: 一介平民成为起义军首领，由此走上了开创汉朝的道路。

people.name: Liu Bang
people.role: Rebel leader, later Emperor Gaozu of Han
people.role_zh: 起义军首领，后为汉高祖

story: Li Si had helped the First Emperor unify China and had joined Zhao Gao's plot to put Huhai on the throne. But under the Second Emperor, Zhao Gao held the real power and saw Li Si as a rival.

As rebellion spread, Li Si tried to warn the emperor and criticized Zhao Gao. Zhao Gao struck back, accusing Li Si of plotting with the rebels, since Li Si's son, the governor of Sanchuan, had failed to stop them. Li Si was arrested and beaten more than a thousand times until he confessed. His letters of appeal from prison were never delivered.

In 208 BCE he was executed in Xianyang, cut in two at the waist, and his whole family was killed. Leaving the prison with his second son, he said he wished they could once again take their brown dog hunting outside their home town.
story_zh: 李斯曾辅佐秦始皇统一天下，又参与了赵高拥立胡亥的阴谋。可是秦二世即位后，实权落在赵高手中，赵高把李斯视为对手。
起义蔓延之际，李斯试图劝谏二世，并批评赵高。赵高反咬一口，诬告李斯与起义军勾结，理由是李斯之子、三川郡守李由没能挡住叛军。李斯被捕入狱，被拷打一千多下，只得屈打成招。他在狱中写的申诉书根本没有送到皇帝手中。
前208年，李斯在咸阳被腰斩，全族被杀。临刑前出狱时，他对二儿子说，真想再和你一起牵着黄狗，出上蔡东门去追兔子，可惜再也做不到了。
li-si-death.why: The death of the empire's chief architect left Zhao Gao unchallenged and Qin with no capable leadership.
li-si-death.why_zh: 帝国的主要缔造者被杀，赵高再无对手，秦朝也失去了最后的能臣。

quote.zh: 吾欲与若复牵黄犬俱出上蔡东门逐狡兔，岂可得乎！
quote.en: I wish I could take our brown dog with you again and go out the east gate of Shangcai to chase hares. How could that ever be!
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: After Li Si's death, Zhao Gao became chancellor. To find out which officials would dare oppose him, he brought a deer to court in 207 BCE and presented it to the Second Emperor as a horse. The emperor laughed and asked the ministers. Some kept silent, some said it was a horse to please Zhao Gao, and some said it was a deer. Zhao Gao later had those who told the truth punished.

Meanwhile Xiang Yu had broken the Qin army at Julu and Liu Bang was nearing the passes into Guanzhong. Fearing blame, Zhao Gao sent troops into the palace and forced the Second Emperor to kill himself.
He then put the emperor's nephew Ziying on the throne with the reduced title of King of Qin. Ziying, fearing he would be next, had Zhao Gao killed.
story_zh: 李斯死后，赵高当上丞相。前207年，为了弄清哪些大臣敢反对自己，他牵来一头鹿献给秦二世，说这是马。二世笑着问群臣，有人沉默不语，有人顺着赵高说是马，也有人说是鹿。事后，赵高把说真话的人都治了罪。
这时项羽已在巨鹿击溃秦军，刘邦也逼近关中的关口。赵高担心被追究责任，便派兵闯入宫中，逼秦二世自杀。
随后他立二世的侄子子婴继位，称号降为“秦王”。子婴害怕自己成为下一个牺牲品，设计杀死了赵高。
deer-horse.why: 'Calling a deer a horse' became the standard phrase for twisting the truth to bully others, and the episode marked Qin's final collapse.
deer-horse.why_zh: “指鹿为马”成为颠倒黑白、仗势欺人的代名词，这件事也标志着秦朝的最后崩溃。

quote.en: He presented a deer to the Second Emperor and said, 'This is a horse.'
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记
